h1: Back-end development for secure, reliable apps
overview: We build the part of your app that users never see: the server, the database and the rules that decide what happens when someone clicks. We design a clear data model, write the API your front end calls, handle logins and permissions, and add the checks that stop bad data getting in. You get documented endpoints, tests and a deployment on your own cloud account.

faq: Which languages and databases do you use?
Most often Node.js or Python with PostgreSQL, and sometimes PHP or Go. We pick what suits your team and plans for growth. If you need a specific stack, tell us in the form.
Can you connect to an existing front end?
Yes. We design the API around what your screens need, share the endpoint notes and test against your front end. If your front end is not built yet, we provide a simple test page.
How do you keep data secure?
Passwords are hashed, connections are encrypted, inputs are checked and access is limited by role. We never store secrets in code. Security reviews beyond that are a separate service on our site.
You do, in your own cloud account. We deploy it for you and explain the monthly cost beforehand. If you have no hosting yet, the cloud hosting set-up service can handle it.
